versions.changelog:
Initial release of gui-tool: a CLI for desktop GUI automation using grid-based targeting.

- Capture full or window-specific screenshots, with optional grid overlays or zoomed grid cells.
- List and raise window focus.
- Click at current mouse position or precise grid cell (multi-level zoom supported). Right-clicking and between-cell clicks also supported.
- Type text or press keyboard shortcuts in application windows.
- All commands return JSON for easy integration and error handling.
- Pixel coordinates are never used; all actions target grid cell crosshairs for reliable automation.
